summary: Report of two men in a tan older Toyota Camry attempting to get an 18-year-old woman into their vehicle near Union Avenue and Columbus Street. The vehicle was last seen heading northbound on Union Avenue.

Disturbance on the 2800 block of C Street — a subject in possession of a butcher knife, with additional knives reported inside the garage, while the reporting party stayed barricaded in a bathroom. Officers responding.

area: east Bakersfield (Oregon Street, Gage Avenue, Niles Street)
summary: Slow-speed pursuit of a minibike through east Bakersfield — westbound on Oregon Street, then northbound Gage Avenue and across Niles Street. Speeds held between roughly 15 and 37 mph with light traffic.
A 2017 Nissan refused to stop for officers in east Bakersfield, with a unit tracking the vehicle.
A woman reported her ex-boyfriend threw a brick through her vehicle and patio door on Coventry Drive. Officers investigating.
Search for a missing juvenile believed to be with a known associate across from a park; the juvenile was not supposed to be in that person's company.
Two people taken into custody during a vehicle stop; officers cleared the vehicle before continuing.
